description: Single Digital View Project Pipeline is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " Single Digital View Project Pipeline " data table provides greater transparency of major connections pipelines (1MW and above) at SPM and SPD Grid Supply Points (GSP) for existing and new customers looking to obtain a generation connection. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Asset Data, Future Networks. Its keywords are SDV, SPD, SPM, DFES, Connections, Single Digital View. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
